programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks with couples who have the same fights over and over again. One couple fights every time they get in the car. She blames his reckless driving. He says she’s an annoying backseat driver. Find out what happens when she gets behind the wheel! Then, meet a husband who is fed up with his wife for returning everything—from their mattress to his favorite watch…to her engagement ring! Is she a scam artist or is her behavior a reflection of her past? Plus, Dr. Phil addresses his number one concern regarding parents who fight.

His scheme is threatened when Winnetou and his blood brother Old Surehand step in to expose the fraud.

Raised by African American parents, White sees the situation differently and is motivated to fight for his students, who face an almost certain life of crime and prison.

programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks with couples who have the same fights over and over again. One couple fights every time they get in the car. She blames his reckless driving. He says she’s an annoying backseat driver. Find out what happens when she gets behind the wheel! Then, meet a husband who is fed up with his wife for returning everything—from their mattress to his favorite watch…to her engagement ring! Is she a scam artist or is her behavior a reflection of her past? Plus, Dr. Phil addresses his number one concern regarding parents who fight.

programme.desc: Periwinkle, un hada vanidosa, se molesta cuando su espejo mágico le dice que el ser más hermoso es Pitufo Vanidoso, y no ella. Periwinkle secuestra a Pitufo Vanidoso, pero los demás Pitufos acuden al rescate. Periwinkle se da cuenta de que ha obrado mal y se convierten en amigos.

programme.title: Kids Planet
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: A Taste of Italy with Nisha Katona
programme.desc: Marlborough is a region of New Zealand, at the northeastern tip of the South Island. It’s well known for Marlborough Sounds, an extensive network of coastal waterways, peninsulas and islands. This area also boasts some of the world’s best walking tracks, taking in coastal forest, coves, inlets, and spectacular skyline ridges. Marlborough’s diverse landscapes – from valleys of vines to sheltered waterways – offers the perfect destination for a week of unrivalled fun and adventure.

This area also boasts some of the world’s best walking tracks, taking in coastal forest, coves, inlets, and spectacular skyline ridges. Marlborough’s diverse landscapes – from valleys of vines to sheltered waterways – offers the perfect destination for a week of unrivalled fun and adventure.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: He is a legend of French television, an iconic presenter, director and man of culture. Antoine de Caunes has influenced generations with his unique sense of irreverence. He comes to tell us about his relationship with art and to talk about "Antoine de Caunes, la vie rêvée d'un enfant du rock", the Canal+ documentary series. Also with us is Marguerite Li-Garrigue, one of the most promising artists on the contemporary scene: a unique universe, a rare intensity and a passion for insects, at the heart of delicate and powerful works. Canadian painter Kent Monkman as seen by Alex Vizorek, in the Vizorek'xpert column.
